[b]->[/b] New map "Wipeout"


[b]Major update for all runners![/b]

[b]->[/b] New car "Chasseur Static"
[b]->[/b] New car "Mako" ( Car DLC )
[b]->[/b] New map "Highway"
[b]->[/b] New map "Beach"
[b]->[/b] New map "Drift Track 3"
[b]->[/b] New map "Desert"
[b]->[/b] New map "Usui"
[b]->[/b] You can now use your own in-game music
[b]->[/b] A better system for painting cars has been implemented
[b]->[/b] A car skin/livery system has been added
[b]->[/b] New anti-aliasing option
[b]->[/b] New Shader option ( better graphics )

[b]->[/b] You can now use your own in-game music
[b]->[/b] On xbox controller, you can now rotate the camera with the right joystick

notes.title: Update V2.5
notes.notes:
[b]Dear drivers,[/b]

Who asked for a tofu delivery?

The map "Hilltrack" is now available in Beta.

[b]Why Beta?[/b]

Because the map is not really finished and this allows players not to wait several months before it is released.

The map is not entirely in the "low poly" graphic style of the game. So tell me what you think about that.


[b]You can therefore encounter different bugs in this map: [/b]

- Getting stuck in the walls
- Less strong AIs
- Texture bugs in the map
- Falling into a void ( no map limit)

[b]To finish the race you have to do the descent, then finish at the bottom a sign will tell you to turn around and then go up to the finish line at the top.[/b]


[b]->[/b] The camera bug that didn't follow the car in the "Port" map has been fixed


Reminder: You can change cameras with the C key

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34918836/7a5bc593db4376f427d5a6e88cf1b33cd8ea8e74.png[/img]

[i][b]Thank you for your support ![/b][/i]
